notes: Everything else follows the instruction set: distributive coordination into two build events sharing one agent, Patient for the created objects, 'paper_factory' fused with its head-noun genus only (noun modifier correctly not exposed), Past on both events, one Name per proper noun, and correctly no LocatedIn on the created hotel.
